objective: Implement the framework-neutral catalog engine and the dedicated search worker so that a query returns ranked project ordinals without the main thread ever building a fuzzy index.
prohibitedChanges: No card rendering or visual design
No hosted search service - PRD 7.4 migration is metric-triggered, not preemptive
Do not reduce the relevance judgement fixture
No Fuse import reachable from the main-thread bundle
deliverables: Prebuilt-index loader; the index is never constructed on the main thread
Exact-match bypass, sequence cancellation, transferable Uint32Array results
URL serialization wired to the frozen grammar
acceptance: Every exact project id ranks top-1
Top-5 recall at least 95 percent on the labelled suite
Query p95 within SEARCH-QUERY-1300 and SEARCH-QUERY-10000
Filter timings within FILTER-P95-1300 and FILTER-P95-10000
A v2 protocol message terminates the worker and activates fallback
Property test: arbitrary facet selections match a naive reference filter over 10,000 randomized cases
